title: Multi-Platform: Desktop & Mobile (Android/iOS) Verification

acceptance.criterion: Desktop build completes with exit code 0
acceptance.command: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY=$(cat src-tauri/fastfree_updater.key) bun run tauri build

artifacts.type: PE32 Windows GUI, Nullsoft Installer self-extracting archive

acceptance.notes: First run exited 1 because TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY was unset; with the repo key set (as CI does) the build exits 0.

acceptance.criterion: Web bundle transforms cleanly under 10 seconds
acceptance.notes: Correctness is clean (exit 0, no errors). Dev on-demand transform is 71 ms. Production build is 21-31 s on this host; ~6 s is esbuild minify, remainder is module-graph transform + chunk render + asset emission (Quasar stylesheet, Sass, fonts).

acceptance.criterion: Single codebase proven across Desktop, Web, and Mobile targets

tauri_android_init.error: Android SDK not found at C:\Users\FastFree\AppData\Local\Android/Sdk (ANDROID_HOME unset)

cargo_check_android.error: cc-rs: failed to find tool "aarch64-linux-android-clang": program not found (Android NDK missing)

mobile_details.ios: no gen/apple scaffold; iOS builds require macOS + Xcode (unavailable on Windows)

findings.title: Committed minisign private updater key
findings.detail: src-tauri/fastfree_updater.key is tracked in git and matches the pubkey in tauri.conf.json. Anyone with repo read access can sign malicious updater payloads.
findings.recommendation: Move the key to a CI secret and rotate the keypair.

findings.title: Hardcoded pnpm virtual-store alias in vite.config.ts
findings.detail: The @quasar/extras alias points at node_modules/.pnpm/@quasar+extras@2.1.0/node_modules/@quasar/extras, which only exists under a matching pnpm install.
findings.recommendation: Resolve @quasar/extras through the workspace package's node_modules instead of a .pnpm path.

findings.title: Production web build exceeds the 10 s target
findings.detail: vite build takes 21-31 s on this host (dev transform is 71 ms). ~6 s is esbuild minify.
findings.recommendation: Profile the module-graph/CSS pipeline; consider manualChunks and Windows Defender exclusions for node_modules.

findings.title: tray-dialog window not listed in capabilities/default.json
findings.detail: windows lists only main and splashscreen; the tray-dialog window receives no core permissions from the default capability.
findings.recommendation: Confirm tray-dialog needs no permissions, or add it to the capability window list.

environment_side_effects: node_modules store migrated pnpm -> bun by a bun add run from a scratch dir inside the repo; repaired with bun install (384 packages, exit 0). bun-added package.json workspaces/overrides reverted and bun.lock removed. No tracked file changed by this work.
